## Prologue

- Hydrogym's official example has 'Fludic pinball control'.

![pinball](images/pinball_example.png){width=50%}


---

- It controlls obstacle's radius velocity to decrese drag and lift.

- Example controlled at Re=100 and Re=150.

- Writer says 
>RL agents discover coordinated rotationstrategies achieving ~90% of drag reduction through counterrotating rear cylinders that inject momoentum into the wake ....

---

## Apply to DFG 2D -3 benchmark

- Pinball example looks very simular to DFG 2D -3 benchmark.

![benchmark](images/turek.png){width=50%}

- Also benchmark's Re# is 100

---

### Enviroment

- VMware workstation virtual machine , Ubuntu 24.04.3

- Download Firedrake and HydroGym on venv.

### Learning

- Object Function

$$
J=\frac{C_D}{3}+(\frac{C_L}{0.4})^2+(\frac{\omega}{10})^2
$$

- Train with PPO algorythm.
